faq.a: Khamzat is associated with the Arabic form حَمْزَة, whose core sense is khamzat; hamza (caucasian form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Khamzat?
faq.a: Khamzat is associated with Arabic. Khamzat is the Chechen form of Arabic حَمْزَة (Ḥamza), a male given name borne by the Prophet's uncle.
Yes — the underlying form حَمْزَة is Arabic.
Khamzat can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Khamzat should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ḥamza is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Khamzat mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Khamzat is rendered حمزہ and carries the sense حمزہ، شیر خدا.

faq.q: What does Khamzat mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Khamzat is rendered حمزه and carries the sense حمزه، شیر خدا.
A romanized syllable approximation is kham-zat. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Khamzat?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Khamzat, khamzat. Script forms are حمزه, حمزہ, حَمْزَة, ख़मज़ात.

faq.q: Is Khamzat a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
